claims.quote: The Teddy Livebearer, as it is called to distinguish it from the actual Dwarf Livebearer Heterandria formosa, originates from Colombia.
The tiger teddy, Neoheterandria elegans, is a small livebearer endemic to the Río Atrato drainage in northwestern Colombia.
